deferred.reason: HOTRAITS.TXT has three probability-bearing native slots and includes war machines. The current JSON contract stores creature ranges but not slot inclusion chances or non-creature war machines; importing a partial array would change the meaning.
These JSONB columns are deliberately null-only in the current contract. The H3C/H3M files support typed data, but importing it first requires reviewed closed JSON shapes and validator tests.
